mapper.sql: r.update_id as id, r.bug_id as bugId, r.state, r.note as content, r.customer_id as customerId, r.decision_hash as decisionHash, r.before_image as beforeImage, r.after_image as afterImage, date_format(u.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as time
mapper.select: select from jiedan_issue_review r join jiedan_bug_update u on u.id = r.update_id where r.bug_id = #{bugId} order by r.update_id desc limit 1 for update

select from jiedan_bug b join jiedan_issue_review r on r.update_id = (select max(rr.update_id) from jiedan_issue_review rr where rr.bug_id = b.id) join jiedan_bug_update u on u.id = r.update_id where b.order_id = #{orderId}
select request_hash from jiedan_issue_review where bug_id = #{bugId} and sender_id = #{senderId} and request_key = #{key} for update
mapper.update: update jiedan_issue_review set state = #{state}, decision_hash = #{hash} where update_id = #{id} and state = 'pending'
update jiedan_bug b join jiedan_issue_review r on r.bug_id = b.id set b.status = r.prior_status, r.state = 'cancelled' where b.order_id = #{orderId} and b.status = 'confirm' and r.state = 'pending'

update jiedan_bug b join jiedan_issue_review r on r.bug_id = b.id set b.status = r.prior_status, r.state = 'cancelled' where r.customer_id = #{customerId} and b.status = 'confirm' and r.state = 'pending'
